transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
For the past few weeks, I’ve had this heavy sadness on me almost all day. At work I can smile and do what I need to do with patients, but inside I feel like I’m barely holding myself together.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?
Yeah. After my shifts I used to paint, or go to yoga or salsa to decompress. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I ignore texts too—none of it really feels worth the effort.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down and unmotivated before, or is this the first time?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time like this before.
Did anything specific or stressful happen in your life around the time these feelings started?
I guess it started shortly after I found out I was pregnant. It’s been about three weeks now.
How has your sleep been over these past few weeks?
I’m not sure—I haven’t really paid much attention to my sleep lately.
How have your energy levels been over the past few weeks?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed whether my energy has changed.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over the past few weeks?

Yeah. Food just hasn’t sounded very appealing most days. I know I should be eating regularly, especially now, but I’ll get halfway through a clinic shift and realize I’ve only had crackers or coffee all day.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt lately?
I’m not really sure what you mean by that. I haven’t noticed anything specific like that.
Have you had any trouble concentrating or focusing lately?
Yeah. At work I keep rereading medication orders or wound-care notes because my brain feels foggy. Things I’d normally decide pretty automatically make me freeze up and second-guess myself.
Have you had any thoughts of death or hurting yourself during this time?
I have had thoughts like… I wish I just wouldn’t wake up. That’s what scared me enough to say something at my prenatal appointment. But I don’t have a plan to hurt myself.
